question: What assets across all markets — stocks, crypto, forex — are showing RSI above 70 right now?
result_summary: count>=40 (capped floor), universe=27740 combined. All 40 returned results are Crypto (.CC): ETH-USD.CC (RSI 70.7), BTC-USD.CC (RSI 70.7), ALEX-USD.CC (RSI 71.2), BORG-USD.CC (RSI 70.6), CBETH-USD.CC (RSI 71.0), DMTR-USD.CC (RSI 87.4), EPIK-USD.CC (RSI 74.3), etc. Zero forex (.FOREX) or stock tickers appear despite those being in asset_type.
reason: RSI values are all confirmed above 70 and crypto is included, but no forex or stock tickers appear in the 40-item buffer. The multi-asset breadth acceptance criterion fails — a blind client sees only crypto as overbought.

defects.desc: When asset_type includes multiple classes (Common Stock + Crypto + Currency), the result buffer is entirely populated by Crypto assets, giving a blind client a false impression that no forex or stock assets are overbought. Separate screens confirm stocks and forex DO have RSI-overbought hits, but the combined screen's ranking/volume causes crypto to crowd out the buffer entirely. No diversity guarantee or note is provided.
